issues.quote: Total assets stood at $65.7 million at the end of fiscal 2024
issues.problem: The unit is wrong. NVIDIA's total assets at the end of fiscal 2024 (January 28, 2024) were about $65.7 billion, not million. That makes the stated figure 1,000 times too small.

data.summary: Every figure matches NVIDIA's reported fiscal 2024 results except total assets. Revenue was $60.9B, up from $27.0B in fiscal 2023, which is growth of about 125.9%. Net income was about $29.8B, operating income about $33.0B, and cash and cash equivalents about $7.3B. The error is total assets, given as $65.7 million when it should be $65.7 billion. The text said all figures were pre-verified and asked for VERIFIED on each, but I checked them anyway, so the report is not fully accurate.
